components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-background-ui); color: #fff; padding: 5px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-background-ui); border-radius: 12px; font: 600 14px/20px "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-logo-primary); border-color: var(--color-logo-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-logo-primary) 25%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.94); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral supporting actions on settings surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-text); padding: 5px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 12px; font: 600 14px/20px "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-green) 10%, transparent); border-color: var(--color-brand-green); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-green) 20%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { filter: brightness(0.96); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Default text and credential entry field.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 240px; background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-text); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px/20px "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-brand-earth); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-logo-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-logo-primary) 20%, transparent); outline: none; }

components.name: Settings Group
components.description: A flat grouped container for related configuration rows.
components.css: .ds-settings { overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 16px; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; } .ds-settings > div { min-height: 56px; padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-settings > div + div { border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-border) 80%, transparent); } .ds-settings strong { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-settings span { color: var(--color-mid-gray); font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Selected destination in the narrow Kotha sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { width: 152px; min-height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--color-background-ui); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font: 600 14px/20px "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--color-logo-primary); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-logo-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active:active { filter: brightness(0.94); }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Theme-aware binary setting control with RTL-compatible thumb travel.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 44px; height: 24px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-toggle span { width: 44px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-mid-gray) 20%, transparent); transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-toggle span::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset-block-start: 2px; inset-inline-start: 2px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; transition: transform 150ms ease; } .ds-toggle input:checked + span { background: var(--color-background-ui); } .ds-toggle input:checked + span::after { transform: translateX(20px); } .ds-toggle input:focus-visible + span { outline: 4px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-logo-primary) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Badge
components.description: Compact active or recommended status marker.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-logo-primary); color: #fff; font: 500 12px/16px "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; }

components.name: Recording Overlay
components.description: Signature compact recording state with the brand color movement.
components.css: .ds-overlay { width: 172px; height: 40px; padding: 0 15px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-mid-gray) 22%, transparent); border-radius: 24px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-background) 98%, transparent); color: var(--color-mid-gray); font: 400 12px/16px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-logo-primary); } .ds-wave { height: 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; } .ds-wave b { width: 4px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-brand-earth); } .ds-wave b:nth-child(2n) { height: 16px; } .ds-wave b:nth-child(-n+3) { background: var(--color-brand-green); } .ds-wave b:nth-last-child(-n+3) { background: var(--color-brand-vermilion); } .ds-overlay > span { justify-self: end; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Kotha is a focused desktop instrument: warm paper and charcoal establish a quiet working ground, while the approved calligraphic wave/K supplies the human voice. The identity is expressive in the wordmark and recording signal, then restrained everywhere the user configures a task.

The system is compact, border-led, and operational. Familiar rounded controls, one calm settings column, and a narrow logo-anchored sidebar keep attention on configuration and state. Vermilion marks the active task; forest and earth support hover, progress, and the wave from speech to text.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces paired with ink-like text and dividers.
A forest-to-earth-to-vermilion brand movement inherited from the approved Kotha artwork.
Compact controls with generous enough targets, clear focus, and restrained motion.
Flat surfaces at rest; depth is reserved for transient UI.
The original Handy runtime contracts remain visually invisible and functionally unchanged.

rules.name: The Wordmark Leads Rule
rules.body: Preserve the approved wave, calligraphic K, terminal accent, lettering proportions, and color movement. Do not redraw the brand from generic type or substitute a stock microphone mark.

rules.name: The Active Field Rule
rules.body: Use a solid Grounded Action field for the selected or primary state; use translucent Forest, Earth, or Vermilion only for subordinate feedback.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Every reusable color enters through a shared semantic alias with a tested light and dark value. Component-local brand hex values are drift.

rules.name: The Signal Is Semantic Rule
rules.body: Warning and error use their theme tokens; brand vermilion is not a substitute for destructive meaning.

rules.name: The Utility Scale Rule
rules.body: Keep application hierarchy between 12px and 16px; the wordmark supplies display presence while the interface stays scan-friendly.

rules.name: The One Working Column Rule
rules.body: Keep one primary settings column in the remaining window; do not convert operational preferences into a dashboard grid.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Persistent surfaces separate through tone and hairlines. Do not add glass blur, gradients, or resting drop shadows to make containers feel important.

rules.name: The Radius Follows Scale Rule
rules.body: Increase radius with container scale; do not apply full-pill geometry to rectangular settings fields or cards.

dos: Do source all reusable color from src/styles/theme.css and keep light, dark, system, and explicit overrides aligned.
Do let the Kotha wordmark anchor the sidebar and preserve generous clear space around it.
Do reserve the solid Grounded Action field for the primary or active task.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, logical RTL edges, localized copy tolerance, and familiar desktop-control behavior.
Do use the Forest–Earth–Vermilion sequence when a component represents voice movement, especially the waveform.
donts: Don't redraw, recolor, crop, or typeset a replacement for the approved Kotha artwork.
Don't reintroduce the discarded generic pink utility palette or component-local brand hex values.
Don't turn the settings window into a card dashboard, marketing surface, or decorative showcase.
Don't add gradients, glass blur, or resting shadows to persistent controls and containers.
Don't rename internal Handy identifiers, bundle/storage paths, updater contracts, settings keys, shortcut IDs, or backend events as part of visual work.
